title: Animated Wire MicroSim
description: Interactive simulation visualizing electron flow through a wire circuit with controllable speed and spacing parameters
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Electric Current
Electron Flow
Wire Conductors
Circuit Animation
Current Visualization
learningObjectives: Explain why electrons must travel a complete closed loop for current to flow through a conductor
Predict how increasing the speed slider changes the current the animation represents
Distinguish electron spacing from electron speed as two independent contributors to the rate of charge flow
Explain what the moving red circles represent and how the animation relates to electron drift velocity
Compare electron flow in a wire with water flowing through a pipe, identifying where the analogy holds and where it breaks down
